x_reason: This promotes the native unit's x_uncovered proposal, which I checked against source. markdown_refs (links.rs:39-68) calls line_context for every link_destination and every code_span. line_context (links.rs:71-76) copies and folds the whole enclosing line through String::from_utf8_lossy and fold_line before truncating to 256 characters, so N references on one line cost O(N x line length). The pass runs over every caller-written .md body during reindex (indexing.py:330 -> _assess_and_split -> extract_link_work). It has no wall budget and holds the one reindex lease, so index freshness stalls for every agent on the store. No unit owns markdown_refs or the reindex chunk pass for this class: the native unit excluded computational amplification, and the compute unit never reached indexing.py.
x_hardening: replace() builds its multi-match error from every match's line number and 7-line context (replace.py:321-333), so the returned error string grows linearly with match count (8000 matches for a 16 KB file); cap the listed matches at a small number.
levenshtein (replace.py:66) also allocates a full (n+1)x(m+1) Python list matrix, so memory is O(n*m) as well as time; a two-row implementation bounds the memory to O(m) even before a time cap.

local_checks.result: Sweep at TRASH_ROOT runs subtrees([ROOT], read_write) (backend.py:857-859). Any other address runs targets(modify) plus subtrees(read_write) (backend.py:860-862). This matches the documented developer-plane contract, under which the purge of live rows is intended. The purge deletes the content, blob, version, version_subject, chunk, segment and edge rows for each id (trash.py:567-591). vfs_versions has no reader anywhere in src (only the mint at versions.py:151-153 and the purge at trash.py:581), and base.py exposes no history verb, so retained versions of tombstoned rows are not disclosed through any verb.

local_checks.result: Any occupied destination, tombstoned or live, is refused with exists (topology.py:173-177). Move stamps label_of(destination postures) on the root and all descendants (topology.py:315,370-377). Copy stamps owner_for(authority) and the destination label (topology.py:452-453) and copies only live rows. Copying readable data to a place where others can read it is ordinary read-then-write capability and is intended. When the subtree is judged sequentially, these paths are sound.

The copy duplicated bob's unreadable file into /mine/c, owned by alice, and alice then read 'BOB SECRET'. The sweep destroyed bob's file permanently, and the delete tombstoned it. The sandbox is SQLite only, and SQLite's BEGIN IMMEDIATE serializes all writers, so a real concurrent commit cannot happen here.

(1) entry.py:225-244 measures content_hash only when data is not None or source=='text'. So Entry(path='/x.pdf', source='bytes', data=None, content_hash=H) validates and keeps the caller's H. entry.py:208-213 and 542-548 also let model_validate(context={MEASURED_BODY: BodyMetrics}) vouch any hash for real data. (2) base.py:2633-2645 (_route_entry_batch) accepts caller Entry objects after an isinstance check and the path gate only. writes.py:160-171 and 1172 store entry.content_hash as given. writes.py:987 gives a bodiless row no content or blob row, and writes.py:1181 marks it render_status='pending'. So the donor's rendered text is written into the attacker's own row, and the attacker reads it back with read. In the reverse direction, a planted row with attacker bytes and a vouched hash H becomes the donor, either by having the lowest id or as the first twin in a page (render_rows seen-dict). A victim's later upload with hash H then gets attacker-chosen derived text, and grep, glean and chunks are built from it. It also drives the version-mint skip (versions.py:146). The hunter must settle one open question: how a lower-trust principal gets H. LIST_FIELDS is path and kind only (reads.py:107). Ways to get it include a prior read, a publicly known document, or the render_status difference as a membership oracle for a guessed H. The hunter must also confirm the full write -> reindex -> read lineage on InMemoryStorage. No existing candidate fingerprint touches content_hash, render dedup or caller-authored metrics. The rendering unit's checks cover parser cost and units_from_json only.
